open_points.subject: model_fields model recognition
open_points.text: “Knows Nothing. It reads values of the models of `models` without naming any of them.” Yet “A model is a value of one of the models of `models`, whichever it is; every other value is answered as no model.”
open_points.question: How does `model_fields.model_items` identify exactly the values declared by `models`, reject every other value, and discover their declared fields and order when it may neither know `models` nor use any named reflection contract?
options: Declare that `model_fields` knows `models` and consumes an explicit model-type registry or descriptor it provides.
Restore the dependency on Pydantic's base model and reflection API, while specifying how non-Registry Pydantic models are rejected.
Give Registry models a declared marker/reflection protocol that `model_fields` recognizes without naming individual models.
Have each caller supply the model schema or type metadata with the value.
open_points.default_guess: Make `models` expose an explicit registry of its model types and field descriptors, and declare that `model_fields` knows that contract.
